blocks.text: The Brownstones — Classic Architecture Meets South Surrey's Leading Address

parts.t: There are few townhome communities in all of South Surrey that make as immediate and lasting an impression as

. Drawing architectural inspiration from the iconic brownstone rowhouses of New York and Boston, this distinguished community brings a sense of permanence, character, and elegance to Grandview Surrey — a neighbourhood already synonymous with quality living.
The Brownstones were built by Adera at 15833 26 Avenue, next to Morgan Crossing and about 0.3 km from the shops. The streetscape feels residential, with rows of brick-fronted homes.

Homes have three or four bedrooms, arranged as two storeys over a ground-level tandem garage, and have rooftop decks, some with North Shore mountain views. Residents share a 1,300 sq ft clubhouse with fitness, games and meeting rooms.
Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator)

items.t: 1,300 sq ft, fitness and games rooms

parts.t: Inside the Brownstones, homes are about 1,250 to 1,700 square feet, with 3 or 4 bedrooms on two storeys above a ground-level tandem garage. The original finishes included hardwood, stone and imported ceramic tile.
Kitchens have granite counters and stainless steel appliances, and each home has a tandem garage.
The Brownstones are registered as strata plan BCS2824. Review the current fees, bylaws, depreciation report and minutes before you write an offer.
The complex was built to Built Green standards, and its brick exteriors and rooftop decks give it a look that's different from most South Surrey townhomes.
Jared Gibbons — Top 1% Fraser Valley Realtor

"The Brownstones have a look you don't see much in South Surrey: brick fronts, rooftop decks and Morgan Crossing about 0.3 km away. If you're considering buying or selling here, I can show you recent sales and what's on the market now."

blocks.text: Morgan Crossing — South Surrey's Leading Walkable Village

parts.t: Morgan Crossing is more than a shopping centre — it's a carefully designed village-style community that sets the standard for suburban walkability in BC. From the Brownstones, residents enjoy direct pedestrian access to a strong mix of retailers, restaurants, services, and green spaces.

blocks.text: Brownstones at Morgan Crossing — Common Questions

parts.t: What is the price range for the Brownstones at Morgan Crossing?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent Brownstones sales and current listings.
How large are the homes at the Brownstones?
Most Brownstones homes are about 1,250 to 1,700 square feet, with 3 or 4 bedrooms on two storeys above a ground-level tandem garage.
What makes the Brownstones different from other South Surrey townhomes?
The Brownstones take their cue from New York and Boston brownstones, with brick exteriors, a connected row-house streetscape and rooftop decks, some with North Shore mountain views.
How often do Brownstones homes come up for sale?
It varies. Setting up a property alert with Jared means you're notified when a unit lists.
What are the strata fees at the Brownstones at Morgan Crossing?

Strata fees vary by unit size and change over time, so confirm the current fee and what it covers for the unit you're considering. A full strata document review — including depreciation report and minutes — is strongly recommended before any offer. Jared can connect you with a qualified strata lawyer to assist.
Are there homes for sale at Brownstones at Morgan Crossing right now?

Listings at Brownstones at Morgan Crossing come and go quickly. Check the South Surrey townhome search above, or call or text me at 604-928-1361 and I'll set up an alert for new Brownstones at Morgan Crossing listings.
What should I check before buying at Brownstones at Morgan Crossing?
Ask for the Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report. I review these with every buyer before subjects are removed.
